title: suderra.site-bundle.v1 site files and RBAC manifest for a site-config update
description: What root fetches from the site_bundle_url of a suderra.site-config.v1 statement on the update channel (channels.json update_channel, ADR-048 DEC-4.12). The site-config update request carries only the signed statement, which fits the agent's hand-over bounds; the site files and the RBAC manifest it names by digest travel in this one document instead, because they can be larger than a command may carry. The document is unsigned: every byte of it is checked against the signed site config (site-file-digest-mismatch, rbac-manifest-digest-mismatch), so a substituted or truncated document can only fail the update. It has the members of an edge-provisioning delivery that the site config names (delivery.json), and root installs them the same way (delivery.json installation). Because the URL is part of the signed statement and may be time-limited, the cloud serves it only for the statement's window; the document itself carries no secret beyond the site's own configuration.

rbac_manifest.description: suderra.rbac-manifest.v1 envelope the site config names.

site_files.description: Base64 bytes of every site file the site config names, keyed by its fixed path.
